note: Intern-S1-Pro (interns1_pro / interns1_pro_text) inherits Qwen3-MoE's per-head q / k norm, but neither type is in QKNORM_ALWAYS: classify gives qknorm=no (over-credit). Same class as qknorm_by_code_unlisted; no diff hunk carries it (the norm is inherited unchanged).
stepfun-ai/Step-3.7-Flash (step3p7) classifies qknorm=no although step3p7 is in QKNORM_ALWAYS (unverified: a nested-config path?).
kanana2_tiny (per-head Qwen3-style q / k norm) and mask_moe (OLMoE copy, whole-projection q / k norm = qknorm=proj) classify qknorm=no; mask_moe also has an uninspected layer-gate softmax.
Phi-3-small-8k does not classify (its only RoPE key is rope_embedding_base); the 128k sibling does.

Configs with no model_type (LongCat, Edge0, BitCPM, MiniCPM4-0.5B, Ming-asr text_config) fall through every type-keyed table, and their '?'-prefixed renorm / group keys collide across unrelated families.

model_graph's comment that a Mamba-2 time_step_min floor is no variant reasons that it is below fp32's smallest softplus output; Nemotron-3-Super and Zamba2 clamp dt at 0.001, which is a real floor. Edges between codes with and without the floor hold only if a host's time_step_min is a free config value.

_gen treats use_bidirectional_attention as bidirectional only when it equals 'all'; Gemma-1 / 2 / 3 code treats any truthy value as non-causal (EmbeddingGemma-300m, not in hub_10k, sets True). No hub_10k gemma config sets it today.
dims_of ignores config attribute_map aliases in general (JetMoE kv_channels -> head_dim found; other renamed head-dim / width keys may hide).
_nope_attention reads use_rope even when it is an audio-tower key (ArkASR / Audio8-ASR): any wrapper whose config carries an audio / vision use_rope is labelled NoPE.
BIAS_QKV_TYPES treats an absent use_qkv_bias as True; StableLM's class default is False (only a GGUF stub omits the key today).
qwen2_moe / qwen3_moe sliding-window layer rules differ between transformers 4.57 and 5.18 (tf5: even layers i < max_window_layers; Qwen3-MoE: every layer); no snapshot turns use_sliding_window on.
hy_v3 code uses mlp_layer_types (default: layer 0 dense) and ignores first_k_dense_replace, which the classifier reads; they agree only because every snapshot sets 1.

MiniMax-M3 configs carry num_nextn_predict_layers / num_mtp_modules but the MLX text-only snapshot classifies mtp=no (unchecked for the full snapshots); minimax_m3 also sets use_gemma_norm ((1 + w), a fold).
moe_sig gives top-k 18 for NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B-NVFP4 while sampled block_configs have per-block top-k 4 - 12 (MTP block 22): origin of 18 not traced.

The classifier follows transformers 4.57 config classes; 5.18 changes some code paths (e.g. Gemma hidden_act 'gelu' rewritten to the tanh form; kimi_linear drops the KDA gate lower bound). The sweep diffs 5.18 where a type exists there.
